por_vs_para.overview: POR and PARA both translate to 'for' in English but have distinct uses. PARA generally indicates purpose/destination/deadline; POR generally indicates cause/means/exchange/duration.

para.core_meaning: Indica objetivo, propósito, meta (Indicates goal, purpose, objective)

uses.example: La zanahoria es buena para la vista.
uses.example2: Las nueces son buenas para el cerebro.
uses.english2: Walnuts are good for the brain.

uses.example: El proyecto es para el martes de la próxima semana.
uses.english: The project is due for next Tuesday.
uses.explanation: Indicates a deadline (fecha límite, plazo fijo)

uses.use: Recipient / Destination of Persons or Things
uses.english: I'm buying a shawl for you.

uses.example: Luis para ser un entrenador, no está en forma, Luis está gordo.
uses.english: For being a trainer, Luis isn't in shape, Luis is fat.
uses.explanation: Contrast between expectation and reality (para ser un/a...)

uses.example: Las donaciones son para los niños de África.
uses.english: The donations are for the children of Africa.
In my opinion, everything is possible.
The bus is heading to Cuenca.
uses.explanation: 'En dirección a' - direction of movement (contrast: 'desde' = departure point)

idiomatic_expressions.english: It's not a big deal, relax.
I'm not available for anyone (right now).
I'm not in the mood for jokes.

por.core_meaning: Indica causa, medio, intercambio, duración (Indicates cause, means, exchange, duration)
por.note: Homework note: 'Tiene sentido' - Focus on making sentences with POR that make logical sense

uses.example: Él concluyó el trabajo tarde porque el feriado viene.
uses.english: He finished the work late because the holiday is coming.
uses.explanation: Note: 'porque' (because) is related but distinct from 'por qué' (why)

uses.example: El niño sube las escaleras con cuidado.
uses.english: The child goes up the stairs carefully.

uses.explanation: Contrasts with 'para Cuenca' which shows destination

uses.example: Compré el libro por diez dólares.
uses.english: I bought the book for ten dollars.

uses.explanation: POR indicates a span of time

uses.english: I spoke with her by phone.

practice_sentences_por.english: The zebra fled from the lion.

practice_sentences_por.spanish: Los niños leyeron el libro de dinosaurios.
practice_sentences_por.english: The children read the dinosaur book.

practice_sentences_por.spanish: Yo toqué el saxofón en la escuela.
practice_sentences_por.english: I played the saxophone at school.

practice_sentences_por.spanish: Paso a paso y poco a poco.
practice_sentences_por.english: Step by step and little by little.

practice_sentences_por.spanish: Yo jugué fútbol con mis amigos en el parque.
practice_sentences_por.english: I played soccer with my friends in the park.

meanings.example: A las 4 de la tarde, tengo una reunión.
meanings.english: At 4 in the afternoon, I have a meeting.

meanings.example: Yo estudié piano a los 11 años de edad.
meanings.english: I studied piano at 11 years of age.

idiomatic_expressions.spanish: a la izquierda, a la derecha
idiomatic_expressions.english: to the left, to the right

ante.meaning: delante de / en presencia de (in front of / in the presence of)
ante.example: Ante esta situación, vamos a suspender las clases presenciales.
ante.english: Given this situation, we're going to suspend in-person classes.

bajo.meaning: indica localización o duración (indicates location under/below, or duration)

examples.english: I want a table for 4 people.

meanings.example: Voy al parque con mis amigos.
meanings.english: I'm going to the park with my friends.

meanings.example: El niño sube las escaleras con cuidado.
meanings.english: The child goes up the stairs carefully.

meanings.example: Me corté el dedo con el cuchillo.
meanings.english: I cut my finger with the knife.
